Finding closure:
- R254-001 CLOSED: pending requires an active restart control. Once it settles without a new process, another report returns not-restarted and sends one manual /exit -> pij revive notice. crates/daemon/src/auth_recovery.rs:199-209,248-256,311-320,446-448. Regression a_restart_that_settles_without_a_new_process_is_reported_once covers both Done and Failed and one notice: crates/daemon/src/auth_recovery_tests.rs:267-290.
- R254-002 CLOSED: a live ledger entry uses monotonic Instant; spine/wall-age reconstruction is only a fallback without that entry, not a way to expire the live monotonic brake. crates/daemon/src/auth_recovery.rs:146,190-198,270-306. Regressions a_wall_clock_jump_never_ends_the_window and a_daemon_restart_remembers_the_window_from_the_spine: crates/daemon/src/auth_recovery_tests.rs:296-305,325-335.
- R254-003 CLOSED: the shared Ledger provides one per-seat Tokio mutex over read/decide/persist/enqueue. The global map guard is released before awaiting; other seats use different locks. No composer/delivery path acquires this ledger and no new lock cycle was found. crates/daemon/src/auth_recovery.rs:113-133,190-257. Regression two_reports_at_once_queue_one_restart produces one restart, one pending result and one control: crates/daemon/src/auth_recovery_tests.rs:310-320.
- R254-004 CLOSED: PID or process-start mismatch returns 409 E-RS-AUTH-STALE before recovery mutation. crates/daemon/src/http/auth_error.rs:63-86. Regression a_lost_login_report_from_a_replaced_process_restarts_nothing: crates/daemon/tests/copilot_compact.rs:324-342. The extension's exact tuple/no-error-text regression is .copilot/extensions/pij/store.test.mjs:1489-1535.
- R254-005 CLOSED: recipients are the registered parent and each held project's designated prime, deduplicated and excluding self/tombstones. Authority comes only from the store: registry parent, open holdings and project prime_id, not report-supplied recipients or legacy prime-role inference. crates/daemon/src/auth_recovery.rs:373-400. Regression the_parent_and_each_projects_prime_are_told_once covers multiple projects, parent/prime overlap and self exclusion: crates/daemon/src/auth_recovery_tests.rs:340-352.

Security and operational checks:
- The extension reports the registered Copilot host tuple, not its extension child. Bootstrap resolves/rechecks the Copilot ancestor, registration stores that host tuple, and tuple() reuses it: .copilot/extensions/pij/extension.mjs:201-205; .copilot/extensions/pij/store.mjs:450-462,1536-1538,2578-2610. Existing host-versus-child/PID-reuse regressions passed CI.
- E-RS-AUTH-STALE response details expose only the reporting PID and seat identifier, not credentials, the original error text, or the current process tuple.
- With no role in a project, the seat's non-tombstoned parent is the only recipient; without such a parent there is no recipient. There is deliberately no unrelated machine-prime fallback. This follows project designation authority rather than inventing an additional project relationship.
- Existing session/Copilot/caller bindings and shared settled-idle, empty-composer and hold-limit brakes remain intact. Restart is the destructive policy. Idle/composer/cooldown conditions are one-directional brakes: removing them permits the same operation in more states.
- No tokens, account/tenant identifiers, enterprise hostnames, or non-layout private paths were found in the delta or reviewed PR body. No new credential reads/logging were found. Original session-error text is not transmitted.
- Per-seat locking has static no-cycle/no-cross-seat-lock evidence, not an independently measured live latency guarantee. No new polling loop, timer or direct daemon launch site was found. Live fleet cost receipts belong to the separate performance review.
